boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Toledo-campus spaces documented by Mercy College for studying, support, reflection, wellness, and campus connection.

cards.title: Mercy College Library
cards.subtitle: Sixth Floor, Jefferson Building
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or laptop, then use the physical collection, computers, printing, and study seating during posted library hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus study-and-research base with collections, computers, printing, and places to work.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College identifies its Library as a place to study, print, or hang out, with computers and physical collections; it lists the location as Sixth Floor Jefferson.
cards.access_notes: Listed library hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; the college says hours may vary.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Sixth Floor, Jefferson Building
cards.notes: Choose a collaborative or private work area that fits the task, and use the wired furniture to connect a personal device.
cards.short_summary: A renovated sixth-floor setting built around different study preferences.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College says the sixth-floor renovation includes a Learning Commons with collaborative spaces, private areas, and wired furniture supporting personal devices.
cards.source_title: Mercy College of Ohio Unveils New Library with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Located within the renovated sixth floor near classrooms; confirm building access through the College before visiting.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Madison Building
cards.notes: Schedule an advising or tutoring appointment when you need help planning coursework, strengthening study skills, or setting academic goals.
cards.short_summary: One office linking students to advising, tutoring, counseling, and retention support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center provides academic advising, tutoring, counseling, and retention support and is listed on the first floor of Madison.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; evening appointments are available upon request.

cards.title: Student Center
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Madison Building
cards.notes: Use this first-floor Madison stop to meet a math or science tutor and arrange a face-to-face session for an individual or small group.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor Madison destination associated with in-person academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College lists its Math and Science Tutor at “1st floor Madison/Student Center” and describes face-to-face tutoring for individuals and small groups.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring is appointment-based; use the College scheduling links or contact the Student Success Center.

cards.title: Testing Center
cards.subtitle: M5802, Fifth Floor, Madison Building
cards.notes: Schedule ahead for an accommodated test, make-up exam, placement test, or distance-education proctoring rather than arriving unannounced.
cards.short_summary: A proctored-testing location for several academic testing needs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Testing Center provides proctoring for accommodated tests, make-up exams, placement tests, and distance-education external proctors; it is in M5802.
cards.access_notes: Appointments require 48 hours’ advance notice and a valid ID. Listed hours: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Fri 8 a.m.–noon.

cards.title: Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Second Floor, main Jefferson entrance
cards.notes: Follow the posted signs from the main Jefferson entrance, and review the College flyer and waiver information before using the facility.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus fitness room with cardio equipment, weights, mats, and locker rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College says its fitness room has treadmills, exercise bikes, free weights, weight machines, mats, and locker rooms on the second floor by the Jefferson entrance.
cards.access_notes: The College directs users to follow posted signs and provides a fitness-center flyer and waiver form.

cards.title: St. Joseph Chapel
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Mercy College
cards.notes: Stop in for quiet reflection, or join the Wednesday-noon prayer service if that form of community gathering suits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor chapel open to all for reflection, prayer, and weekly services.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College says St. Joseph Chapel is on the first floor, open to all, and used for quiet reflection, sharing, prayer, and Wednesday-noon prayer services.
cards.source_title: The Office of Ministry and Mission | Mercy College
cards.access_notes: The College describes the chapel as open to all; weekly prayer services are Wednesdays at noon.

cards.title: Mercy College Food Pantry
cards.subtitle: Mercy College Toledo campus
cards.notes: If groceries would help, visit while the College is open and complete the anonymous QR questionnaire after using the pantry.
cards.short_summary: A no-appointment campus pantry available to Mercy College community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College states that its Food Pantry is available to all students, faculty, and staff, requires no appointment, and may be visited whenever the College is open.
cards.access_notes: No appointment is required; the College says individuals may visit anytime the College is open.

cards.title: Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: Madison 5617, Madison Building
cards.notes: Use this named gathering space to connect around campus programs that center multicultural awareness, respect, and appreciation.
cards.short_summary: A Madison 5617 gathering space for the college community.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College’s catalog identifies the Multicultural Center in Madison 5617 as a welcoming space for students, faculty, and staff to gather, celebrate, and support one another.
cards.source_title: Mercy College of Ohio College Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog places the center in Madison 5617; confirm current room access and programming with Student Affairs.

cards.title: Jefferson Lobby
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Jefferson Building
cards.notes: Use the main entrance near the front desk as a clear meet-up point when you are arriving for a scheduled campus event or visit.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor entrance lobby used for campus registration and information tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy College event information identifies the Jefferson lobby near the front desk as the main entrance and a registration point; College communications also document information tables there.
cards.source_title: PA Program Interview Day | Mercy College
cards.access_notes: Access depends on College building hours and the purpose of your visit; the front desk is near the main lobby entrance.
